description: This file defines an immutable implementation of a JSON field within the project, encapsulating a key-value pair with optional definition metadata. It provides methods for creating instances, retrieving properties, equality checks, and string representation, indicating its role in representing JSON data structures.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonField
classes.description: An immutable representation of a JSON field consisting of a key and a value with optional metadata, providing methods for access, comparison, and serialization.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonField instance with specified key and value, optionally with a definition.

methods.name: getKeyName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the key.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the JsonKey object associated with this field.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the JsonValue associated with this field.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonFieldDefinition if present.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks if the field is marked with a specific marker or markers based on its definition.

methods.name: writeKeyAndValue
methods.description: Serializes the key and value to the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare key and value for equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides a hash code based on key and value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns an escaped string representation of the JSON field, caching the result for efficiency.
